subject: Lee
text: Lee's d4444 trivializes the Arcade ladder on any difficulty: if blocked to the end, wait for the punish, block, and repeat; if the opponent rolls back, let the first kick hit and keep mashing 4 so the last kick hits on their way up. It also works for the 5 minute achievement.

evidence.quote: Lee's d4444 makes this a cinch. If the opponent blocks the string until the end, wait for their punish, block, and try again.

If they attempt to roll backwards, let the first kick hit them, keep mashing 4, and the last kick will hit them on the way up. This trivializes the arcade ladder run on any difficulty, including this one.
You can also do this for the 5 minute speedrun cheevo

subject: Long Journey
text: Moves with huge block recovery give unavoidable damage: King's df1 is the easiest, or Nina/Anna's ff4 for range and safety (roll back immediately if it hits). For the sister fight (fight 8), get the health lead early.

evidence.quote: King's df1 is the most infamous and probably easiest to do, I went with Nina/Anna's ff4 because of its range and relative safety.
If it gets blocked, you get your free hit in. If it hits (you don't want this), you can just roll back instantly.
For the sister fight (fight 8), get the health advantage as early as possible
